description: Open browser URLs, inspect sessions, inspect open app context, and run approved desktop actions. For existing user Chrome/ChatGPT, open URLs with persistent=false, choose windows with computer.select_window focus=false, mark clicks with the virtual AI cursor, and enter words with computer.type instead of repeated key presses. chrome_background_control only describes Chrome DOM entry through Apple Events, not the whole computer-use surface. Use payload.background=true or driver=auto to try Chrome background text/key entry first; set payload.allow_foreground_fallback=true when the user permits overlap so the tool can focus the target and use foreground keyboard input if Chrome blocks the background route.

config.name: browser_computer
config.summary: Approved browser and computer actions. Use computer.context before screenshots/clicks, persistent=false for the user's existing Chrome, computer.type for text input, and computer.select_window with focus=false when targeting an app/window in the background. For Chrome, payload.background=true or driver=auto tries DOM background entry first; payload.allow_foreground_fallback=true lets the tool switch to normal foreground input when the user allows overlap.
